thread:
Maya Chen: FYI — Orchard AI invoice ORC-2025-09 (USD 58,200) is 45 days overdue. They stopped their dedicated cluster last week. SRE got a ping but no payment commitment. Need a plan: collections, payment schedule, or escalation. @Raj @Elena please advise.

Raj Patel: Can you drop the invoice lines here? I'll check payment methods and PO status.

Maya Chen: Quick snapshot:
```
Invoice: ORC-2025-09
Issued: 2025-10-01
Due: 2025-10-30
Amount: $58,200.00
Status: Past due 45 days
Auto-collect: failed (2025-11-04)
Notes: Cluster suspended 2025-11-10 per SRE request
```

Elena Novak: Thanks. Customer replied to CS saying cashflow issues, asked for a 90-day plan. Any guardrails we want? (late fees, service restrictions, signature) :thinking_face:

Maya Chen: My proposal: require 30% upfront, then two equal installments 30 days apart. No interest if they sign agreement by EOD Friday; otherwise standard late fee applies. Also keep auto-fallback to restricted access if a payment misses >5 days.

Leo Sanchez: Sounds reasonable as a short-term concession. If >90 days, route to legal/AR for a structured settlement. Also flag for sales exec to pause renewals until resolved.

Raj Patel: I'll confirm whether there is an existing PO. If they have a PO we can try net-30 on a short exception. If not, go with Maya's 30/35/35 or 30/40/30—which is better?

Elena Novak: Prefer 30/40/30 so more cash earlier. Offer a 2% processing fee waiver if they sign the plan in 48h.

Maya Chen: Drafted outreach below — please review/edit.

Raj Patel: paste it here and I'll tweak tone.

Maya Chen:
```
Subject: Payment plan proposal for overdue invoice ORC-2025-09

Hi Team —

We understand your current constraints and want to keep your services running. To avoid further disruption we can offer a short-term payment arrangement: 30% due now, 40% due in 30 days, 30% due in 60 days. We will waive the 2% processing fee if the agreement is signed within 48 hours. Please confirm acceptance and we’ll send the payment schedule + secure link for the initial payment.

If we don’t hear back by [DATE +48h], we will need to escalate and may restrict access per contract.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Finance Ops
```

Raj Patel: Minor edit for urgency + ask for PO number. Add: "Please confirm the PO or payment method so we can process the first installment." Looks good otherwise. :+1: 

Elena Novak: Also add a line offering a 15-minute call to unblock any questions — reduces friction.

invoices-bot: Reminder: auto-collect failed on 2025-11-04 for ORC-2025-09. Retry scheduled 2025-11-18.

Maya Chen: OK — I'll send the revised email with edits and the proposed schedule at 15:00 PT today. Raj — can you loop in Sales if we don't get a signed plan within 48h?

Raj Patel: Yep. If no signed plan by 48h I'll flag to Sales Director and start escalation to collections.

Leo Sanchez: Before escalation, if they accept the plan but miss the second installment, we should automatically move to interest/collections. Need Legal sign-off for any >60-day arrangements — @Maya make a quick Legal ticket if we go beyond 60 days.

Maya Chen: Will do. I'll post the sent email here and follow up with any replies. Tracking thread for audit. :memo:

Elena Novak: Thanks team — keeping this on my CS radar so I can help nudge the customer. :eyes:

Maya Chen: Sent at 15:02 PT — copied thread. Will update with customer reply.
